title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 70

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 70
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 70
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st October 1979]
No. 70
In Martial Law Order No. 47 in
paragraph 2, in sub-paragraph (a) at the end after the words "had his
headquarter", the words "or in case of a Governor of a Province, the
Chief Secretary of the Government of that Province" shall be added and
shall be deemed to have always been so added.
